meta.title: Proposed US in-app purchase price chart (USD) for the museum match-3
meta.storefront: US App Store and Google Play US (same USD price points on both)
meta.status: PROPOSAL. Every price, amount and ratio below is an ESTIMATE (our design), built on competitor prices that are FACT or REPORTED as marked in each basis entry. Nothing here is in economy/default.json or in the game yet.

statusLegend.FACT: seen on the cited source on 2026-10-23 (US App Store page / Apple catalog API, the game's own help page, or this repo)
statusLegend.REPORTED: secondary source (fan wiki, analyst, forum); may be older than 2026-10-23
statusLegend.ESTIMATE: our own inference, design choice or arithmetic

ourCoinScale.averageFreePlayerCoinsPerDayNote: default.json shop.adForCoins comment: 'about 420 coins' a day for the average free player (skill-55, three 10-minute sessions)
ourCoinScale.boosterPricesStatus: start boosters: proposed from the simulator (measured); the four in-level boosters: placeholders, not measured. Any bundle value that counts in-level boosters is therefore uncertain.
ourCoinScale.livesNote: Lives are not sold today (GAME_DESIGN section 23: 'can satilmaz'). With 5 lives and 10-minute sessions lives end no session of the average player (section 25), so unlimited-life time has little value for most of our players.

storeFees.basis: Apple Small Business Program 15% (FACT, https://developer.apple.com/app-store/small-business-program/); Google Play US, first $1M a year: 10% service fee + 5% Play Billing fee (FACT, https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/16954621). Net values below are price x 0.85, before sales tax and VAT handling (ESTIMATE).

pricingRulesProposed: P1 Coins per dollar never falls as the price rises; the top visible pack gives at most +35% over the entry pack (genre at $19.99: +24% to +33%).
P2 Each coin pack holds about a whole number of '+5 moves' (900 coins) with less than one +5 left over, and the shop shows 'about N times +5'.

P3 A real-money bundle's or piggy bank's coin value (coins + boosters at prices.boosters) is at most 1.6 times the coin ladder at its price; the starter pack at most 2.5 times and once per player; the season pass is outside this rule because its value is earned by playing.
P4 No product holds random contents; every content is listed before purchase (section 17/19: no paid random items; Apple 3.1.1, Google Payments policy).
P5 No purchase touches a level's move limit, seeds or assist (section 17).
P6 Only store price points ending in .99; no product above $19.99 at launch.
P7 Every purchase has a confirm step and is never charged on a single tap from a fail screen (FTC Epic order, 2023-03-14).
